analysis: The trial succeeded operationally and achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5000: Movies_and_TV 0.580, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.505, Electronics 0.390, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.525. This is +0.0025 over the supplied prior result of 0.4975, but −0.0050 below the baseline of 0.505. Endpoint weighting therefore yielded a small observed aggregate improvement without recovering baseline performance; Electronics declined from the supplied prior 0.400 to 0.390. These results do not establish a causal explanation or statistical significance. The experiment used 430.90 allocated GPU-seconds. No test results were available.
code_summary: Trained one independent SASRec model per category from scratch, with dataset routing and exactly one selected checkpoint loaded per category. Each network has 96-dimensional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.2, normalized item/sequence scoring, and jointly trained item bias and score scale. The isolated change weights selected transitions by exp2((position − final_window_position)/8), then normalizes weighted sampled-softmax losses within each history and averages histories equally. Training retains prefix augmentation, at most 24 selected transitions, 256 sampled negatives, training-history exclusion masks, AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, and validation checkpoint selection. Predictor generation, supplied splits, seeds, and evaluation interfaces remain unchanged; no ensembles or checkpoint averaging are used.
